svg.title: UML activity: an honest recap, then a safe export
svg.desc: UML initial and final nodes, action nodes, decision and merge diamonds, and guarded transitions represent the runner/application recap flow. Missing results loop to selection. Finisher and known-DNF paths merge before optional data and rendering. Export failure preserves results and allows retry.

g.title: error
